headline: Otero's double, Hudler's single walk off Astros in 11th
recap: Ricky Otero doubled with one out in the bottom of the 11th and scored on Rex Hudler's single, giving the Phillies a 6-5 win over the Houston Astros.

Mike Hampton started for Houston and allowed four runs on four hits over seven innings; Matt Beech matched him for Philadelphia, giving up four runs on seven hits in seven innings. Craig Biggio's two-run homer, his 17th of the season, staked the Astros to a 4-0 lead in the second, and Hudler's own two-run homer in the seventh tied it at four.

Kevin Stocker's single put the Phillies ahead in the eighth, but Bill Spiers singled home the tying run for Houston in the ninth. Billy Brewer pitched a scoreless 11th to pick up the win; Tom Martin took the loss after allowing the Otero-Hudler rally.
